text: Ok well lets do grass and flowers and bushes next. pick one or do all 3 since we know it will work
resolution: Extended the slim 24-byte instance format from fronds to ALL foliage cards — grass, bush, and flower (req_2019). Generalized the frond-specific infra into shared foliage-card infra (FrondInstance->SlimInstance, g_frond_*->g_slim_*, makeFrondInstance->makeSlimInstance) since it now serves two pipelines (rule-of-two); the frond FAMILY names stay. grass_wgsl now rebuilds the model matrix from TRS like frond_wgsl (grass/bush/flower are yaw-only, pitch=0), and the draw-loop is_slim predicate routes both g_grass_pipeline and g_frond_pipeline through the slim buffers in the static + per-frame paths. Water deliberately stays on the 80B InstanceData path (large oriented surfaces). Grass blades are the single highest-count thing in the world, so this is the biggest memory + despawn win of the series. Editor (v8_app) and no-V8 loader both build green; grass renders correctly (upright, green gradient) in shots/slim_foliage_check.png — user can eyeball live via rjit game play. Shipped in d990ee74f.
